tile.$description: Inbox tiles: 17.1pt dark, 15.4pt light. Plus or minus 2 pt.

card.$description: The Changes card in a thread: 15.4pt in both themes. Plus or minus 2 pt.

banner.$description: The photo-access card in the Context sheet: 11.9pt.

menu.$description: Pull-down and pop-up menus (iOS 26 glass): 32.4pt pull-down, 30.7pt pop-up, both dark.

sheet.$description: Top corners of a sheet: 35.8pt on the half-height Model sheet, 37.6pt on the full-height Customize sheet (light).

capsule.$description: Fully round ends: the composer, search fields, filter chips, segments, the Continue and '7 PRs' capsules, and the round nav, icon and send buttons.

base.$description: Measured gaps land on multiples of 4 pt within a pixel or two.

sm.$description: Gap between a row's title and its subtitle line, and inside chips.

md.$description: Gap between Inbox tiles: 11.5 pt across and 11 pt down (size.tile.x, size.tile.y), and the composer's inset from the screen edge (12 pt).

lg.$description: Inbox tiles' inset from the screen edge: 16 pt.

xl.$description: Screen margin for text, rows and cards: titles and row icons start 20.5 pt in, the Changes card 19.5 pt.

screenMargin.$description: Left and right margin of titles, rows, replies and cards.

row.$description: Single-line row (Projects, Workspaces, Customize, Add Workspace), divider to divider.

rowTwoLine.$description: Agent row with a status line (title, then branch state, diffstat and repo), dot to dot.

navButton.$description: Round glass back, close, search and filter buttons: 44pt x 45pt in dark, rim included.

composer.$description: Composer capsule height (380pt wide in dark).

composerPanel.$description: The composer once it has text: a panel with the model picker, microphone and send along its bottom.

composerButton.$description: Round + and microphone buttons inside the composer.

searchField.$description: Search field height in a sheet (glass capsule).

segment.$description: Segment height in the Pull Requests sheet (light only); 'All' is 43pt wide.

width.$description: Inbox tile width, rim included: two tiles per row.

iconButton.$description: Round action buttons in the agent details sheet: 41.5x40.5pt dark, 42x42pt light.

avatar.$description: Profile avatar (an initial on a grey circle).

menuWidth.$description: Pull-down menu width (268pt); the Group by pop-up is 272.5pt.

chartBar.$description: Width of one bar in the profile charts; bars have round tops.

heatDot.$description: Dot in the profile's activity heatmap (light only).

touchTarget.$description: Nav buttons, rows and the composer are 44 pt or more. Chips (38 pt), the send button (35 pt) and the composer + (36 pt) are smaller and sit inside larger bars.

hairline.$description: Row dividers and the tile rim: the divider is anti-aliased over two device pixels (border.dividerColour reads the darker row), so about 1 pt.

base.$description: Not determinable from pixels. The letterforms are a neo-grotesque close to the iOS system face; use the platform font.

mono.$description: Not determinable from pixels. Inline code, chart axis labels and the version footer use a monospace face; use the platform monospace.

regular.$description: Body, rows, subtitles, stat values. Judged by stroke width, not measured.

medium.$description: Large page titles and the agent title in its details sheet. Judged by stroke width.

semibold.$description: Sheet titles and bold runs in agent replies. Judged by stroke width.

largeTitle.$description: Large page titles (Inbox, All Agents, a repo name). Cap-height readings: 22pt.

statValue.$description: Big numbers on the profile (947M, 71, 3d). Cap-height readings: 22pt.

detailTitle.$description: The agent's title in its details sheet, centred. Cap-height readings: 21pt.

profileName.$description: The account name on the profile. Cap-height readings: 19pt.

title.$description: Sheet titles (Profile, Model, Customize). Cap-height readings: 16pt, 17pt.

body.$description: Agent replies, row titles, menu items and the composer. Cap-height readings: 16pt.

subheadline.$description: Row status lines, section and group headers, chips, tile labels, stat labels and empty states. Cap-height readings: 15pt.

code.$description: Inline code in agent replies. Cap-height readings: 15pt.

caption.$description: Chart axis labels and dates; the version footer uses the same monospace in upper case. Cap-height readings: 10pt.

notTokenised: iOS 26 glass (nav buttons, the composer, search fields, menus, the 7 PRs and Continue capsules): blur and refraction come from the system material
Continuous (squircle) corners: DTCG has no value for corner smoothing
Shadows: the light theme's glass controls and menus carry a soft shadow; it was not measured
Line heights of titles and one-line labels: only multi-line blocks were measured
The activity heatmap in dark: the profile bottom was captured in light only
